events.title: ONE Ocean : Singapore's Premier Immersive Ocean Exhibition at Science Centre
events.overview: Experience ONE Ocean: Every Action Ripples , world's first immersive ocean exhibition in Singapore that transforms marine science into a cinematic, multi-sensory experience. Featuring free-roaming VR (virtual reality), 360° cinematic projections, spatial audio, and interactive marine science and research inspired by 20 years of Tara Ocean Foundation expeditions . Discover Arctic exploration, coral ecosystems, ocean biodiversity, and Singapore's marine heritage in a journey unlike any other.
events.venue: AND PARKING Where is the exhibition located? The experience is located at Science Centre Singapore, The Annexe Halls. Easily accessible alternative to crowded lifestyle hubs like Gardens By the Bay, Marina Bay Sands, National Gallery Singapore, or Sentosa. Is there parking available? Yes, Science Centre Singapore offers parking facilities for the guests. Are there lockers and or a coat check on site? There are lockers located around the Centre for rent. Are there bathrooms available at the venue? Yes, toilets are available. TICKETING Where can I get tickets? Tickets are available via this link: ONE Ocean: Every Action Ripples - Science Centre Onsite Store Comprehensive bundle tickets include entry to the main Science Centre and Omni-Theatre, making it one of the most value-packed places to visit in Singapore. Can I buy tickets on site? Yes, onsite tickets can be purchased if available. We recommend purchasing tickets online in advance to secure your spot. I cannot find my ticket. What can I do? Please check your recently deleted emails or spam folder first. If you are unable to locate your tickets, you may contact us at ticketing@science.edu.sg for assistance with ticket retrieval. What methods of payment are accepted on site? Payment can be made with credit and debit cards. Can I reschedule my tickets? Changes to the date or time of your experience are allowed, if the request is made at least one month before the original scheduled date of your experience. Do note that all changes are subject to availability. To make a request, please email ticketing@science.edu.sg and include your ticket reference ID. Is it possible to transfer a ticket to someone else? Yes, tickets are transferable at no cost. Simply forward the PDF tickets to the intended recipients Can I re-enter once I’ve exited the exhibit? Please note that One Ocean tickets are for single entry only. While you may return to the main Science Centre after exiting, you cannot re-enter One Ocean. Are tickets refundable? NO REFUND / UPGRADE / DOWNGRADE of tickets will be made under any circumstances. If an event/movie is postponed or cancelled by SCS, SCS will endeavour to inform the customer via telephone or email where possible. Any refund made by SCS shall be in accordance with the price paid by the ticket holder for the ticket. SCS shall not be liable to make a refund beyond the paid amount under any circumstances. In the event of cancellation by SCS, all tickets purchased using credit cards shall be refunded back to the same credit cards. Refund will not be entertained if customer does not claim the refund within 1 month from the date of cancellation. HEALTH AND SECURITY Can the virtual reality experience be uncomfortable or unsuitable for certain people? The virtual reality experience is safe and enjoyable but potentially uncomfortable for certain people. It is not recommended for people with claustrophobia, heart problems, and a history of seizures, epilepsy, or sensitivity to flashing lights or 3D. People prone to motion sickness are also more likely to experience discomfort using a virtual reality headset. Vertigo may persist and increase within a few hours of use. Symptoms may also include drowsiness. These symptoms may increase the risk of injury when undertaking normal activities in the real world. Can a person with a heart condition or epilepsy take part in the virtual reality experience? It is not recommended for a person with a heart condition or epilepsy to participate in the activity. Can children do virtual reality alone? The VR experience is recommended for children aged 9 and above. Children aged 9-12 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian for the VR experience. Please note that the accompanying adult cannot supervise or assist the child during the virtual reality segment. Can you do the VR experience with a child in a baby carrier or stroller? Due to the nature of the VR experience, strollers are not permitted. Can a deaf or hard-of-hearing person follow the experience? You can still do the experience with hearing aids, Please note that the headsets have headphones attached to them and that the volume can be adjusted as needed. VR CODE OF PRACTICE FOR AN OPTIMAL EXPERIENCE Please be attentive to the experiences of others by staying silent or speaking very quietly (if necessary) when conversing with others. Please pay attention to the instructions from our team and follow their advice and tips carefully to ensure you have the best experience possible. Please be respectful of the sensitive equipment and handle it with care. Violence and violent/vulgar gestures are strictly prohibited on the free-roaming floor.

events.title: Yatra – From Sanctum to Screen
events.overview: From South Indian temple traditions to today’s digital screens, bharatanatyam has journeyed through centuries, carrying devotion, identity and transformation. Once performed as an offering to the Divine by Devadasis, dance expressed worship through rhythm, gesture and movement. As social and cultural landscapes changed, the temple tradition evolved from Sadir into modern bharatanatyam , moving from sacred and royal spaces to the gurukulam and stages.

events.title: Yesterday’s Legends to Tomorrow’s Stars
events.overview: Celebrating the legacy of musical theatre and the artists who continue to shape its future, Yesterday’s Legends to Tomorrow’s Stars pays tribute to the generations of composers, lyricists, performers and storytellers who have paved the way for today’s emerging talent. From the groundbreaking genius of Stephen Sondheim to the unmistakable songwriting and performance excellence of Dolly Parton, this showcase honors the diverse voices, timeless stories, and musical innovations and styles that have influenced generations.
